description: Three-model panel that reviews a compiled project spec for completeness, feasibility, and internal consistency before the autonomous build starts. Verdict is 'ready' or 'needs_revision'; the panel must broadly agree the spec is buildable before kickoff.

panelists.focus: completeness: every requirement has an acceptance criterion, every milestone has a Definition-of-Done, every requirement is covered by a milestone, and the runtime test command is real
feasibility and risk: are the milestones and acceptance criteria realistic for the chosen stack, and are the major risks identified with mitigations
internal consistency and testability: acceptance criteria are concrete and executable, ids are consistent, scope is bounded, and there are no contradictions
